title: Percent change
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.rat.percent-change.apply: Find the change first (the percent of the original), then subtract it for a discount or add it for tax, a tip or an increase.
hints.rat.percent-change.find: Find how much it changed, then divide by the ORIGINAL amount and multiply by 100.
hints.rat.percent-change: New amount: find the change, then add or subtract. Percent change: change ÷ original × 100.

misconceptionMessages.rat.change-only-amount: That's the amount of the change. Now take it off (or add it on) to get the new amount.
misconceptionMessages.rat.change-wrong-way: Check the direction: a discount makes the price smaller; tax, a tip or an increase makes it bigger.
misconceptionMessages.rat.change-subtract-percent: The percent isn't dollars. Find 25% OF the price first, then subtract that amount.
misconceptionMessages.rat.change-wrong-base: Compare the change with the ORIGINAL amount (the starting number), not the new one.
misconceptionMessages.rat.change-amount-as-percent: That's how much it changed. To get the percent, divide the change by the original amount and multiply by 100.

sections.title: Sales, tax and tips
sections.objective: Find the new amount after a percent increase or decrease.
explain: A discount is a percent OF the price, taken off.
Tax and tips are a percent of the price, added on.
sections.key: Find the change (the percent of the original amount), then subtract it for a discount or add it for tax, a tip or an increase.

sections.title: Percent increase and decrease
sections.objective: Find the percent change between two amounts.
explain: The percent change compares the change with where you started.
From 50 to 40 is a change of 10, and 10 out of 50 is 20%.
sections.key: Percent change = change ÷ ORIGINAL amount, times 100.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: New amounts and percent changes, mixed.
sections.key: New amount: find the change, then add or subtract. Percent change: change ÷ original × 100.
